dct_title_s: Cyclone Amphan flood detected water for Bangladesh and India
dct_description_sm: This data combines satellite detected water (flooding) for Bangladesh and north-east India during cyclone AMPHAN. This flood raster includes data from ESA Sentinel-1, JAXA ALOS PALSAR 2, TerraSAR-X, MODIS, Landsat and Sentinel 1. The organisations involved in the processing of the data are WASDI Fadeout, Sentinel-ASIA Asian Institute of Technology, DLR German Aerospace Agency, Earth Observatory of Singapore (EOS), NASA Disaster and Bob Adler from University of Colorado.
